question: Please calculate the race completion percentage (all laps completed) for Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009.
predicted_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN res.laps = tl.total_laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN (SELECT raceId, MAX(lap) AS total_laps FROM lapTimes GROUP BY raceId) AS tl ON res.raceId = tl.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.`status` = 'Finished'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS completion_percentage
FROM `results` r
JOIN `races`   ra ON r.`raceId`   = ra.`raceId`
JOIN `drivers` d  ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId`
JOIN `status`  s  ON r.`statusId` = s.`statusId`
WHERE d.`nationality` = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.`year` BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
